Yes, not only Xuanhan Wuxian, but also Gan Ziteng, Xi Xiangfei and other warriors who are enemies of Chu Xiaobei.
At this moment.
Nearly one hundred thousand warriors fell into hell.
The entire Profound Jade Square almost turned into a special volcano, bursting out a horrible howling!
"It hurts--!"
"No, don't cut my flesh piece by piece, ah, no!
"My bones, my hamstrings, my hand tendons, my ears..."
"Kill me, kill me, please give it, give it a go!"
A series of screams broke out, followed by a strong blood!
Those warriors at the bottom of the cultivation base are okay, and they are in pain for more than ten seconds and then cool.
But those with a higher level of cultivation, such as Gan Ziteng, Xi Xiangfei, the old man and their subordinates, were miserable.
For these high-ranking warriors, Su Lang is the focus.
Not only to torture severely, but also to use the rules of life to extract the breath of life from other warriors to continue his life.
The same as before!
Of course, the worst is Wuxian Xuanhan.
As a Five Tribulations Martial Immortal, his vitality is naturally extremely powerful.
Su Lang changed various rules and various tricks to torture him, and he tried almost all the rules he had understood!
"Don't torture me!"
"Please give me a good time!"
"Clan Chief Xuanyue, where are you Chief Xuanyue, please come and save me!"
"I know I was wrong, I shouldn't support the arrest of Chu Xiaobei, I was wrong, I was really wrong!"
"Ah, my eyes, my eyes!"
Xuanhan Wuxian was imprisoned by the rules of space at the feet of Su Lang, screaming and begging for mercy constantly.
In a short period of time, this impossibly noble Wuxian, covered in purple robes, has become even worse than the most miserable stray dogs!
In the distance, countless warriors trembling all over looked at the warriors who were tortured by the power of the rules, their faces turned pale.
At the same time, they are also very grateful that they did not stand in the wrong team.
People like Wang Li and others are very proud.
Among the Xuanyu immortal clan, the vast majority support the exchange of Chu Xiaobei for peace.
It is conceivable that that small group of people must have been under tremendous pressure, and even turned their eyes and humiliated them.
but now.
The enemy who used to be bullying is suffering brutal punishment and suffering.
The justice they insisted on was brought by Su Lang!
"Good abuse!"
"Good torture!"
"My lord is wise, these dogs should be tortured to death!"
"Our Profound Jade Fairy clan finally has a posture of becoming an emperor, you actually want to use her in exchange for peace, you deserve to be tortured!"
The crowd of onlookers made a sparse applause, and immediately more and more people agreed.
In the end, almost all the warriors clapped their hands and praised them, and even wished they would run up to bite Xuanheng and others.
Of course, this also meant to please Su Lang, after all, it was a existence that was even more terrifying than a big demon who killed people without blinking!

chapters.title: Chapter 896: Patriarch, please help me
paragraphs: The scene of Su Lang's punishment still continued.
Nearly one hundred thousand warriors have died nine out of ten, only the mighty Martial God, Martial Saint has not yet died.
Most of these warriors who had not died were already unable to shout, but there were still a lot of people begging for mercy.
Su Lang has never been merciless to those who dare to swear at himself.
With a move of mind, he first ingested some breath of life to heal his wounds, make him live and live, and then impose more cruel punishments on him, so that he knows what pain is.
At this time, no one dared to swear, and could only continue to endure intense pain, gradually dying in despair.
In a blink of an eye, the of war is dead, only the martial sages such as Xuanhan Wuxian and Gan Ziteng are still alive.
And at this moment.
The sky and the earth changed suddenly, the clouds in the sky dispersed, and two martial immortals descended.
One of them had his head covered with withered hair, his figure was rickety, and his dark face was covered with deep wrinkles. He was the patriarch of Xuanyuxian clan, Xuanyue Wuxian.
The other person was expressionless, without saying a word, and immediately behind Xuan Yue, was the third elder of the Xuan Yuxian clan, Xuan Ao Wuxian.
Of course everyone has seen such a big movement of the two martial arts.
"The patriarch is here, the patriarch Xuanyue is here!"
"There is also Elder Xuan Ao, I didn't expect Elder Xuan Ao to also come back!"
"Why did the two Wuxians appear at this time? Are they trying to save Xuanhan Wuxian?"
"It's very likely that Wuxian Xuanhan is also a pillar of our Xuanyuxian clan, no matter what, if he is willing to repent..."
"Let’s don’t guess, we will know what the patriarch and the third elder are coming from."
The onlookers talked for a while, and then calmed down again, turning their gazes to Xuanyue Wuxian.
at the same time.
Of course Xuan Han Wuxian and the others also saw Patriarch Xuan Yue.
"Patriarch, please help me!"
"I know it's wrong, I really know it's wrong, I change it, and I will fight against the Luoyou Emperor Clan together with you!"
"Patriarch, third elder, please let that lord stop, we have died nearly 100,000!"
Xuan Han Wuxian and the others are like drowning people who grabbed a life-saving straw, and they endured the pain and called for help.
They also thought that the reason why Xuan Yue Wuxian appeared now was to save them.
However, something unexpected happened to them.
Wuxian Xuanyue didn't even look at them, came directly to Su Lang and knelt down.
"Xuan Yue pays homage to your lord!"
"Xuan Ao pays respects to your lord!"
Wuxian Xuan'ao also bowed down with Wuxian Xuanyue, a trace of uncontrollable excitement appeared on his indifferent face.
Obviously, he already knew the identity of Su Lang's'Langdi' through Xuanyue Wuxian.
With the cultivation base of the Three Tribulations Martial Immortal, Xuan Ao was really honored to kneel in front of a Martial Emperor so close at hand!
"Two, please.
Su Lang's expression stretched, and he smiled kindly.
Such an approachable behavior immediately made Xuan Ao even more excited!
"This is Langdi, the Langdi who unified the south!"
"I actually received the courtesy of Emperor Lang, this matter must be remembered for a lifetime!"
Xuan Ao slowly got up, dizzy with excitement, as if drunk.
Xuan Yue Wuxian received Su Lang's courtesy, he was also very honored and very excited, but because his temperament was better and his face was dark, he concealed his expression.
The scene where Wuxian Xuanyue and Wuxian Xuan'ao met Su Lang stunned everyone in Xuanyuxian City.
"Xuan... Patriarch Xuanyue actually bowed down to the adult!"
"Oh my God, isn't that Wuxian the same generation as the Xuanyue Clan Chief? What kind of identity is he?"
"Patriarch Xuanyue is the head of the clan, and even the Six Tribulations Martial Immortal, he can step into the ancient fairy realm in just one step.
Can make Xuanyue clan leader kneel down willingly, his identity is at least similar to the Nine Tribulations Martial Immortal! "
"In any case, this martial immortal who shame Chu Xiaobei is definitely an important figure of a big power, maybe it is the origin of the emperor."
"The emperor... the emperor! The great man of the emperor, my God, really!"
"If it's really an emperor..."
Each warrior showed awe, and many people bowed to their knees, knelt on the ground, or even crawled on the ground.

As soon as this remark came out, Wuxian Xuanheng's last hope was immediately lost.
The gaze he looked at Su Lang and others no longer meant to please, but a trace of hatred revealed in despair.
Seeing Wuxian Xuanyue from the tormented despair undoubtedly gave him a glimmer of hope, but now this glimmer of hope has been shattered.
What is more painful and hateful than giving people hope and breaking it down?
However, from another aspect, Xuan Yue also helped him Xuan Heng.
Xuanyue begged Su Lang to take action, then they would not have to suffer any more.
"it is good."
Su Lang also readily agreed, after all, it would be boring to torture.
"death!"
With a thought, the rule of death enveloped every sinner.

"Ding! You get the Soul of the Intermediate Martial Fairy*1, the Enlightenment of Space*1, the regular fairy crystal*1, the top-grade fairy jade*6356451, the middle-grade fairy jade*3565638, the lower-grade fairy jade*84561243... Grade refining material...Holy refining material..."
"Ding! You get the soul of high-level martial arts*1, the lead of space*1..."
A series of system prompts came, and Su Lang's storage space suddenly showed a lot of treasures.
So far, within the Xuanyu Immortal Clan, almost all the warriors who agreed to exchange Chu Xiaobei for peace have died.
Even if there were a few others, they never dared to make a sound anymore, and even had to breathe carefully.
"The aftermath will be handed over to the chief Xuanyue."
Su Lang smiled at Xuan Yue Wuxian.
"My lord, rest assured!"

Su Lang nodded, turned around and removed the barrier of Xuanyu Immortal Stone, and came to Chu Xiaobei's side.

chapters.title: Chapter 898: Xuanyu Immortal Clan’s Heart for Taoism
paragraphs: "Well, do you think I have killed too many people?"
Su Lang looked at Chu Xiaobei indifferently and asked softly.
This time, he directly killed nearly 100,000 warriors of the Xuanyuxian clan, and they were all elites living in Xuanyuxian City.
It can be said that Xuanyu Immortal Clan's seven-channel martial artist has only three channels left at this time.
This is probably from below the heart, all amputations...
"Speaking privately."
"Just to help me humiliate me and kill the culprit, you don't have to kill so many people."
"But I know that you did this to clean up the dross for the Xuanyu Immortal Clan by the way. Although there are few people left, they are all the essence."

"The path of martial arts is the eternal path of the martial artists, the eternal topic, the eternal goal, and the realm of the emperor of martial arts is a dream that every martial artist and every race must pursue."
"If you have the hope of realizing your dream, but you don't chase it, what is the difference with Xianyu?"
Chu Xiaobei said with a smile as if I wasn't fooling you.
"Ooooo."
"Do you still know the allusion of salted fish?"
Su Lang smiled blankly, "Continue to talk about your views."
"Hey, that is!"
"I know a lot about the ancient culture of Blue Star, not only salted fish, but also...cough, get back to business."
"The dross is very harmful, and it is a huge obstacle to the progress of the Xuanyu Fairy Clan."
"If you don't get rid of it, the Xuanyu immortal clan will be difficult to move, suffocating, and even going backwards and decline.
"The people left behind today are all willing to resist difficulties for me and help me pursue my dream of becoming an emperor."
"And what they see is not only me, but also the hope of becoming an emperor in me. They have pinned their dreams on me."
"In other words, when any tribe has the posture of becoming an emperor, they will pin their hopes and support him. This kind of spirit belongs to the heart of our entire race!"
"Because of the desire to seek the truth, I dared to grit my teeth to challenge the powerful emperor and fight for the glimmer of hope in the crack!"
"Now, I am the one that everyone has placed their hopes on for Emperor Cheng, and I must become Emperor to be worthy of everyone!"
As Chu Xiaobei was talking, looking at the sky, his expression became more serious and firm.
"Not bad."
"well said."
Su Lang smiled and nodded.
In his opinion, what happened to Chu Xiaobei can be compared with some things in his previous life.
For example, in the previous blue star, if there is a student showing the qualifications and potential to be admitted to Qingbei University.
Then his whole family would definitely have to confess when they smashed their pots and sell iron, and even if they would not hesitate to beg, they would also provide for their children to study.
If someone in this family refuses to let the student go to school, but lets him drop out of school to work, then this person will definitely be resisted.
If the whole family does not let the students go to school, and let them go to work to earn money, then the family is finished.
The previous Xuanyu Fairy Clan is like the second more serious example.
Su Lang eliminated those who prevented Chu Xiaobei from going to school and asked everyone to support Chu Xiaobei's test of Qingbei.
of course.
This is the world of martial arts fantasy. Everything is spoken with the fist, otherwise no one will listen to reason, so Su Lang's methods appear to be very tough and cruel.
In general, Su Lang became the devil of Xuan Dai, Xuan Heng, Xuan Han and others, but became the angel of Chu Xiaobei and even the entire Xuanyu fairy clan.
And Chu Xiaobei also clearly understood Su Lang's painstaking efforts and made up his mind to never let anyone down.
Xuanyue Wuxian, as the core figure of the Xuanyuxian clan's "heart of seeking Taoism", of course understands better.
Therefore, he supported Su Lang's mass killing from the very beginning, even if he felt uncomfortable, he never pleaded for anyone.
As for Xuan Ao, as Xuan Yue Wuxian's confidant, he also understood.
And the ordinary warriors in the fairy city below may not understand it so well, but they have already felt the desire for Taoism condensed from the entire race!
The entire Profound Jade Immortal Clan has been condensed into a ball, and then, he must look up to the front and chase the dream of becoming an emperor.
In front, there were the Six Dao Immortal Clan and the powerful Luoyou Emperor Clan.

The Liudaoxian clan in the Ming Dynasty was the precursor of the Luoyou emperor, and the Luoyou emperor secretly provided the powerful and resources to support the Liudaoxian clan to attack the Xuanyuxian clan.
The pressure of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan is too great.

If it weren't for the Luoyou Emperor Clan to be able to end in person, and the support for the Six Dao Immortal Clan could not be too obvious, the Xuanyu Immortal Clan would have long been unable to hold it, and would have scattered and fled.
But things are different now.
Chu Xiaobei brought back a strong man, Su Lang!

Everything is spoken with the fist, otherwise no one will listen to reason, so Su Lang's methods appear to be very tough and cruel.
In general, Su Lang became the devil of Xuan Dai, Xuan Heng, Xuan Han and others, but became the angel of Chu Xiaobei and even the entire Xuanyu fairy clan.
And Chu Xiaobei also clearly understood Su Lang's painstaking efforts and made up his mind to never let anyone down.
Xuanyue Wuxian, as the core figure of the Xuanyuxian clan's "heart of seeking Taoism", of course understands better.
Therefore, he supported Su Lang's mass killing from the very beginning, even if he felt uncomfortable, he never pleaded for anyone.
As for Xuan Ao, as Xuan Yue Wuxian's confidant, he also understood.
And the ordinary warriors in the fairy city below may not understand it so well, but they have already felt the desire for Taoism condensed from the entire race!
The entire Profound Jade Immortal Clan has been condensed into a ball, and then, he must look up to the front and chase the dream of becoming an emperor.
In front, there were the Six Dao Immortal Clan and the powerful Luoyou Emperor Clan.

The Liudaoxian clan in the Ming Dynasty was the precursor of the Luoyou emperor, and the Luoyou emperor secretly provided the powerful and resources to support the Liudaoxian clan to attack the Xuanyuxian clan.
The pressure of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan is too great.

If it weren't for the Luoyou Emperor Clan to be able to end in person, and the support for the Six Dao Immortal Clan could not be too obvious, the Xuanyu Immortal Clan would have long been unable to hold it, and would have scattered and fled.
But things are different now.
Chu Xiaobei brought back a strong man, Su Lang!

chapters.title: Chapter 899: But it's really long enough
paragraphs: The dialogue between Su Lang and Chu Xiaobei did not last long.
Because the old lady and others looked at them eagerly from a distance, but didn't dare to come over.
They watched Chu Xiaobei grow up, and gave countless cares and hopes in Chu Xiaobei's life.
At this time the stormy sea subsided, of course they wanted to talk to Chu Xiaobei.
As for Chu Xiaobei, he is not an unreasonable person, and he wants to reminisce with the elders who have taken care of her.
"Go ahead, I happen to have something to do."
Su Lang smiled and pointed to Old Mi and others, and said to Chu Xiaobei.
"Hmm, I'll be back to find you soon."
Chu Xiaobei smiled, and then hopped to find the old woman Mi, like a little girl who has not grown up.
"Oh, you actually said that you will come back to me soon, this girl has become clingy?"
Su Lang smiled brightly, then looked around, his eyes fell on a martial sage.
This Wu Sheng was Wang Li who had led Su Lang into the city before.
Xuan Yue and Xuan Ao went to the aftermath personally, and sent Wang Li, the man who had run errands for Su Lang, to wait for instructions.
"grown ups!"
Seeing Su Lang looking at him, Wang Li opened his eyes and smiled, excitedly ran over to salute.
"Find me a quiet room in the city."
The corner of Su Lang's mouth raised slightly, and he smiled faintly.
"Yes!"
Wang Li bowed and took his orders, "My lord, please follow me.

Under the leadership of Wang Li, Su Lang entered the best quiet room in Xuanyu Immortal City and opened up all the formations to assist in cultivation, which is bound to create the best cultivation environment for Su Lang.
But these were of little use to Su Lang.
The cultivation bases in the sea of his cultivation are simply useless, and there is no need for special cultivation at all.
Sitting cross-legged on the ground.
Su Lang began to take stock of his belongings.
Five system functions were upgraded before, and a total of more than 155 million yuan was spent on the best immortal jade.
So the balance is a little over 90 million.
After that, the number of the best immortal jade has not been supplemented.
After killing the three martial gods Xuan Dai, Xuan Han, and Xuan Heng, as well as one hundred thousand ‘dregs’, Su Lang also got more than two hundred thousand best immortal jade. That’s right.
Therefore, Su Lang's fund balance has basically not changed.
For Su Lang, what is more gratifying is that he has obtained three regular fairy crystals, three Wuxian souls, and some materials.
"At present, the system functions are to be upgraded, and there is a total difference of nearly 10 million fine jade.
"I'm afraid, only by beheading a quasi emperor and plundering all his wealth can he make up for it!"
Thinking of this, the corners of Su Lang's mouth curled up slightly, revealing a sneer, "However, the war is about to start, and I will soon be able to fill this funding gap."
Forget the spoils of harvest.
Su Lang looked at his cultivation status and mental strength again.
The state of cultivation is still the same, constantly increasing, in a state of surplus but not overflow.
But rushing from Yaochi to Xuanyu Fairy City, and going through two more incidents, it seemed like a long time, but it didn't take much time.
Add up before and after, and it's only an hour.
Therefore, Su Lang's mental power has only recovered a twelfth degree, and he is still at a relatively weak level in the realm of the sun.
"We must be the enemy of Emperor Wu."
"My spiritual power has to be elevated to the state of emptiness and nirvana."
"Otherwise, Emperor Luo Youwu will attack him with a mental attack. Even if I won't die, it will be very uncomfortable."

"At my current cultivation speed, my mental strength cultivation will only take another eight or nine hours, and I will be able to reach a state of fullness, and I can break through to empty nirvana."
"The soul-burning plan can only be continued later."
Determined in his heart, Su Lang set his sights on the seven immortal swordsmanship.
The rate of one-key martial arts training is slower than one-key training.
It takes a whole day, or twenty-four hours, to practice a fairy-level exercise.
At this time, it only took a few hours to finish the practice. It would take about twenty hours to complete the practice.
"It's really long enough."
Su Lang murmured a word that caused all warriors in the world to vomit blood.
He couldn't wait to try those seven immortal sword moves named "Broken".
Moreover, Su Lang has always been obsessed with the ‘source of the practice’, and wants to perform his own moves.

chapters.title: Chapter 900: Mountain River City accident
paragraphs: "We can only wait."
Su Lang sighed helplessly, then took out the cauldron and materials, and began to refine the super humanoid weapon.
This behemoth has a total of 120,000 fairy-level parts, and Su Lang has only refined about 6,000 so far.
This is only one-twentieth.
A long way to go!
However, this weapon that was extremely difficult to complete even for Su Lang, once it was completed, it would definitely not know how terrifying it was.
This is also the reason for Su Lang's perseverance.
In the next time.
Su Lang has been refining parts for super humanoid weapons.
Until Xuan Yue Wuxian and Xuan Ao Wuxian ran over to see you.
"Xuan Yue pays homage to your lord!"
"Xuan Ao pays respects to your lord!"
Two Wuxians respectfully knelt down in Su Lang's quiet room.
"Has the aftermath been completed?"
Su Lang kept moving in his hands and asked directly through the quiet room door.
"Return to Sir."
"We have killed some remnants and appeased the rest of the tribe, and the tribe has been completely calmed down!"
Xuanyue Wuxian replied, and his voice immediately changed, "But in this short time, something happened in the border city of Xuanyuxian clan.
"Something big happened in the border town?"
Su Lang asked with a smile, "Did the Six Dao Immortal Clan seize the moment when Xuan Han and Xuan Ao are away, and get into trouble?"
"Return your lord, that's it!"
Xuan Ao Wuxian was a little anxious, "The things Xuan Han and I came back were clearly confidential, but it was still leaked. There are spies in the border town!
And I just received a secret report from my subordinates. Although they killed the spies, the catastrophe has already happened!

The mountain and river city where I was stationed has been captured by the Liudaoxian tribe. The life in the city has been disastrous. All my troops have fled, and two quasi immortals have died in battle! "
Shanhe City is the frontline of the Xuanyu Xian Clan against the Liudao Xian Clan.
This city was not a border city before, and it was even located near the hinterland of the Xuanyu Fairy Clan.
However, the Six Dao Immortal Clan was secretly supported by the Luoyou Emperor Clan, and in the battle with the Xuanyu Immortal Clan, they descended into a city by day and landed at night.
The city near the hinterland became a border city.
This shows how dangerous the situation of the Xuanyu Immortal Clan is.
"Xuanyu Fairy Clan, this big son who fought for Chu Xiaobei to become Emperor, really blocked the entire race!"
Su Lang admired in secret, immediately put away the cauldron, stood up and opened the door.
See the quiet room door open.
Wuxian Xuanyue and Wuxian Xuan'ao suddenly shorted their heads to show their awe.
"The Six Dao Immortals are just dogs and horses who are the precursors of the Luoyou Emperor Clan. They kill the meat before killing their owners!
The Xuanyu fairy clan is now empty inside, Xuan Yue, you are highly respected in the clan, stay and guard, I will send a clone to protect it secretly. "
Su Lang looked at the two people below and smiled, "Xuan Ao, you will lead me to the mountain and river city to kill the dog and horse."
"Yes!"
The two Xuanyue bowed their orders.
Xuan Ao was very happy, because it was a great honor for him to lead the way for the Emperor Lang himself.
"Xuan Ao."
"You go get ready."
Su Lang left a word and left the quiet room to look for Chu Xiaobei.
Yes, he is going to deal with the Six Dao Immortals, so naturally he has to bring Chu Xiaobei.
Firstly, Chu Xiaobei was worried about staying in Xuanyu Immortal City, and secondly, because the Six Dao Immortals had chased Chu Xiaobei and almost killed her.
Although it was said that there was no Six Dao Xian Clan chasing and killing Chu Xiaobei, Su Lang was unlikely to meet Chu Xiaobei.
But one yard goes to one yard, and Su Lang will not spare anyone who has hurt Chu Xiaobei.
When I found Chu Xiaobei.
She is still chatting with the old woman Mi.
In addition to the old woman Mi, Lai Bang and other people gathered around Chu Xiaobei.
From time to time there was exclamation from the crowd.
"It's worthy of being an emperor. In the past few months I have been promoted from a six-star martial sage to a quasi immortal!"
"The cultivation base is second. In addition to the rules of the five elements, I also comprehend the rules of space, the rules of life and death, the rules of yin and yang, etc., and I was blinded!"
"Ms. Chu said that this was taught to her by the mysterious adult. If so, how powerful is that adult!?"
"I think it should be humble words, how can the power of rules be taught, at most a few words, everything can only be understood by yourself."
"Yeah, it's not bad, it's Miss Chu who is fighting for herself. In my opinion, the chance of becoming an emperor is really great!"
"Haha, I tremble with excitement when I think of the day when our Xuanyu clan can also become an emperor!"
